text.card: A red giant 10,330 parsecs away, 19 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.87 solar masses and 18.7 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,922 K at its surface.
